title: UserRoleRequest
description: Set a federated user's stored RBAC role (PATCH /v1/admin/users/{subject}/role body). The role is server-side state written by an existing admin: it is never read from a token, a claim or a header, so no caller can elevate the credential it presents. The env allowlist ADMIN_SUBJECTS is the other admin source and takes precedence — it is checked first on the auth path, so a stored 'user' role cannot demote a subject the operator allowlisted.

role.description: 'admin' (superuser across the whole deployment: every collection, all of /v1/admin/*, /v1/config, the model registry) or 'user'. Any other value is a 400 — including the deprecated 'researcher' alias, which is accepted only where legacy config is READ, never written here. Deliberately NOT an enum: the server validates the vocabulary and answers 400, and a schema enum would make that documented response unreachable from a conformant client (it would be a client-side 422 instead). The response schema DOES pin the enum, because there the server is the writer.
